info.title: FOF API
info.description:
Lets other church apps ask FOF Ops (Foundation of Faith, The Covenant Nation Ikorodu) about people and cohorts: who has taken FOF, how far they have got, and when the next cohort starts.

## In plain words

An API is a secure doorway that lets one app ask another a question without seeing everything inside it. This one lets a church app ask FOF things like "has this member taken FOF?" and get a short, agreed answer back.

- **Only what's needed.** Answers carry names, cohort and progress. Never passwords, access codes, reflections, notes, private messages or guardian details.
- **Real people only.** Practice cohorts, test cohorts and test accounts are left out of every answer.
- **Every request recorded.** FOF records which app asked what and when (never the answer), and can switch any app off at once.
- **History included.** Finished and archived cohorts count, so you can tell whether someone took FOF years ago.
- **One participant per cohort.** Someone who took FOF more than once is a participant once per cohort, each with its own id.

## Getting a key

1. Ask the FOF Ops team for a key, saying which app it is for and which questions it needs to ask.
2. You get a key starting `fof_live_`, shown once and sent privately. It only allows the questions you asked for (its scopes).
3. Keep it on your server. Never put it in a phone app, a web page or a shared chat. If it leaks, tell us and we switch it off.

| Scope | Lets the app |
|---|---|
| `people:lookup` | Ask whether a person is in FOF, by phone number or email |
| `people:read` | Read a person's short profile and programme progress |
| `cohorts:read` | Read the current and next cohort |

## Sending your key

Send it in the `Authorization` header as `Bearer fof_live_…` (`X-API-Key: <key>` also works). Answers are JSON.

Phone numbers are matched the way FOF stores them: `08031234567`, `2348031234567` and `+234 803 123 4567` are the same person. Other countries need the full international number. Every example uses made-up people.

## Limits and errors

Each key can make **60 requests a minute**. Refused requests do not count towards it. Errors always look like `{ "error": { "code": "…", "message": "…" } }`.

| Status | Code | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| 400 | `bad_request` | Something is missing or unreadable, such as the phone number or email |
| 401 | `missing_key`, `invalid_key` | No key, or the key is not recognised or switched off |
| 403 | `missing_scope` | The key may not ask this question |
| 404 | `not_found` | No such person or address |
| 405 | `method_not_allowed` | Version 1 only answers GET requests |
| 429 | `rate_limited` | Over 60 requests a minute; wait for `Retry-After` |
| 500 | `server_error` | A problem on FOF's side; try again shortly |

## Coming next: registering from the church app

Not available yet; being designed with the church digital team.

1. **Register.** The church app sends what it already knows: church ID, name, phone, email (`POST /v1/registrations`).
2. **Fill the gaps.** FOF replies with the few fields still missing, which the person fills in inside the church app (`PATCH /v1/registrations/{id}`).
3. **Login shown.** FOF returns the person's login details and the church app shows them. Their first sign-in asks for a new password.
4. **Later, by email.** Once email is connected, the same login details also arrive in their inbox.

## Changes

| Version | Date | What changed |
|---|---|---|
| 1.0.1 | 29 Oct 2026 | The lookup's list is now called `participants`; the wording says participant throughout |
| 1.0.0 | 29 Oct 2026 | First version: look a person up, profile, programme progress, current and next cohort |

This page is drawn from `supabase/functions/public-api/openapi.json` in the FOF Ops repository, the single source for these docs. The API serves the same file at `/v1/openapi.json`.

fofKey.description: Your FOF API key, starting `fof_live_`. `X-API-Key: <key>` also works.

participants.description: One entry per cohort the person took, newest first.

teamRoles.description: FOF team roles this person holds, for example ADMIN or SUPPORT. Empty if they are not on the team.

present.description: Present, or late or left early with an excuse

lateOrLeftEarly.description: Late or left early, not excused
